skill_name: Explain the historical context of WWI.
workflow: World War I, or the Great War, was a global conflict that lasted from 1914 to 1918. It was fought primarily in Europe, between the Allied Powers and the Central Powers. Its causes can be traced back to the rivalry between the European colonial powers of France and Germany, and their respective allies.
